correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the isomorphism from formal unitization of trivial Q_n to triangular algebra T={(λ,w;0,µ)} where w∈F_q^{n−1}, multiplication (λτ,µν,λz+νw). Nonunits partition A(λ≠0,µ=0), B(λ=0,µ≠0), C(radical nonzero). A_rB_s=0 iff r=s; B kills A∪C; C kills A∪C including self. After deleting C self-arcs, counts |A|=|B|=(q−1)q^{n−1}, |C|=q^{n−1}−1, bidegrees (h,qt−1),(qt−1,h),(qt−2,qt−2), arrow count h²t+(qt−1)²−(t−1). A_r to B_s distinct r,s requires 3 steps, gives diameter 3. Intrinsic ordered bidegrees and matched neighborhood twins imply ((S_h×S_h)≀S_t)×S_{t−1}, and extrema recover q,n. Checked boundary q=2,n=2 and q=3,n=3 count 44 vertices and 704 arrows. The inspected verifier counts *loops* in its local degree test; our loopless deduction explicitly removes those loops.
